text.en:
Section two thousand and seventy-three of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to read
"Section 2073. Permission for official to absent himself from from province.-Except as allowed by law, no
provincial official engaged in the discharge of continuous duties shall leave the province without obtaining
permission so to do from the Department Head: Provided, however, That as regards provincial fiscals and
deputy provincial fiscals, permission to leave the province shall be obtained directly from the
Attorney-General."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 21, 1930.
